text: Ciftoree e ɗiin moƴƴi, nde Alla ñaawani on accude rewde ngaari ndi, nde Muusaa (jkm) wii on: on tooñii ko'e mon e rewde mon ngaari ndi, tuubee ndutto-ɗon e tagɗo on O, mbarondiron, ɗuum ɓuri e mon jokkude keefeeru caasnoowu jayngol, on mbaɗii ɗuum e ballal Alla, O accani on, sabu ko keewɗo yaafaade jurmotooɗo jeyaaɓe Makko.
